name: the briefcase
credit: Made for this fork; AI-drawn with the originals kit (research/clawd-fan/originals/kit).
references: The glowing briefcase from Pulp Fiction (1994): slicked-back hair, skinny black tie, golden light from an unseen inside.

name: zed's dead
credit: Made for this fork; AI-drawn with the originals kit (research/clawd-fan/originals/kit).
references: The chopper getaway from Pulp Fiction (1994): slicked-back hair, leather jacket, a raked chopper with ape-hanger bars, and the line "Zed's dead" as a two-word caption.

name: bullet time
credit: Made for this fork; AI-drawn with the originals kit (research/clawd-fan/originals/kit).
references: The slow-motion bullet dodge from The Matrix (1999): tiny black shades, long black coat, falling green code, bullets crawling past with ripples in the air.

name: thumbs up in lava
credit: Made for this fork; AI-drawn with the originals kit (research/clawd-fan/originals/kit).
references: The thumbs-up in molten steel from Terminator 2 (1991): leather jacket, dark shades, a slow sink with one hand left giving a thumbs-up. Cartoon slapstick: he pops back out fine.

name: moon bike
credit: Made for this fork; AI-drawn with the originals kit (research/clawd-fan/originals/kit).
references: The bicycle flying across the full moon from E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial (1982): red hoodie, a BMX with a front basket and a blanket bundle, the silhouette against a giant moon. No character is drawn.
notes: Deliberate exception to the orange-body rule: while he crosses the moon, the cells of him in front of it are drawn as a dark silhouette; everywhere else he keeps his normal colours.

name: bat country
credit: Made for this fork; AI-drawn with the originals kit (research/clawd-fan/originals/kit).
references: The desert drive from Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas (1998): bucket hat, tinted aviators, cigarette holder, Hawaiian shirt, a red convertible, cartoon bats and the two-word caption "bat country".
